scope: Visible draft, deployed JSON, exact article/action blobs, cited PRs and workflow receipts, executable next steps, chronology, and review/discussion provenance. Read-only review; no acceptance, action or scheduling authority.

findings.title: Known combined-schema failure reported as cleared
findings.explanation: The source-current six-case diagnostic finished before article generation and showed every isolated response section passing while the combined strict form still failed with HTTP 400 schema_complexity. The article instead says all technical blockers are cleared and that the remaining gate is a full live provider run.
findings.correction: State that byte/token fit was repaired but aggregate strict-schema composition remains blocked; #416 stays Draft/pending and another unchanged full-form run is not the next authorized step.

findings.title: Invocation commands are fabricated and the probe grant is spent
findings.location: Owner recovery decision and Suggested actions
findings.explanation: The article invents /editorial-resume and /action-review-probe commands and says owner recovery uses a slash command. The implementation uses structured PR correspondence/API records and a guarded workflow_dispatch. The latest one-time diagnostic grant was already consumed and no further dispatch is authorized.
findings.correction: Name the actual structured comment/API and workflow_dispatch surfaces and their guards. Remove the invented commands and do not recommend repeating the consumed diagnostic without fresh authority.

findings.title: Workflow failure is equated with provider rejection
findings.explanation: The workflow can fail before or after provider contact during source validation, dependency setup, secret-bound execution, transport, output validation or artifact retention. A generic failed run therefore does not itself mean the provider rejected the schema.
findings.correction: Reserve the schema-rejection conclusion for a validated safe artifact that records the provider HTTP/category result; classify other failures by their actual stage.

findings.title: PR 421 findings and lifecycle are misreported
findings.explanation: PR #421 contains six confirmed errors and two unverified claims, all open. It is an independent review-data PR that remains draft for supervised review, not a zero-finding action-review record with an automatic merge/close condition.
findings.correction: Report the six confirmed and two unverified open findings and describe #421 as a proposed/current independent review whose next step is supervised disposition, separate from action review.

findings.title: Morning Cockpit PR was active in the prior window
findings.location: Roadmap pulse and Suggested actions, morning-cockpit #60
findings.explanation: PR #60 was created at 2026-10-21T09:15:28Z, 45 minutes after the prior reporting window began at the 03:30 America/Chicago cutoff. The claim that it had no activity for two windows is therefore false.
findings.correction: Say the PR had no activity in the current window and was created in the immediately preceding window; remove the two-window-idle triage premise.

findings.title: Independent reviewer identity is not authenticated
findings.explanation: The PR records report source-pinned reviews from separate agent contexts, but the shared ojfbot GitHub account is not an independently authenticated human or provider reviewer identity.
findings.correction: Attribute the reviews to separate Codex contexts carried by the shared GitHub account, and avoid implying independently authenticated human/provider identity without additional evidence.
